{{Top|Leg}}
'''Wroosha fabric''' was a type of fabric used in the creation of [[Clothing/Legends|dresses]].<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The scene from ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'' in which [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] is in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] takes place immediately before the film, therefore meaning it must be set in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|dimantid|Mantid, Di}}</ref> [[Di Mantid]] wore a [[Color/Legends|gray]], sleeveless dress made from wroosha fabric<ref name="Who's Who" /> while at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter">''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]]<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" />
